banner.isekai_mahou.cities.siege_won: %s is saved! The Kingdom thanks you.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.info.head: %1$s — %2$s §7[%3$s]
command.isekai_mahou.cities.info.no_alta: Public Ascension Altar: none found yet.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.info.no_ston: Waystone: none found yet (the sweep looks in the plaza).
command.isekai_mahou.cities.info.sweepin: Sweep in progress (chunks loading): %s removed so far.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.info.swept: Sweep complete: %s monster(s) from other structures removed.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.list_empty: No known cities in this world yet (the city heart registers when loaded).
command.isekai_mahou.cities.not_in_city: You're not inside a city (or its heart isn't loaded).
command.isekai_mahou.cities.placed: %s generated near X %s, Z %s. Its heart registers the place when loaded.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.siege_runnin: There's already a siege in this city.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.amb: The bakery's bread just came out warm.
Heard about the Guild? They say it pays well.
The streets are calm, thanks to the guards.
I need to buy thread at the tailor's...
My cousin joined the Academy. Now all he talks about is glyphs.
The tavern is full of stories today.
Watch out for goblins on the road!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.bad: People have been saying bad things about you.
I don't want trouble with you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.cal: Someone call the guard, they're looting!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.ene: Stay away! %s is at war with your people!
Guards! The enemy is in the city!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.exa: Is... is it really you, the hero of %2$s?! May I shake your hand?
The kids play pretend as you in the plaza!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.goo: Thanks to people like you, we sleep in peace.
Friendly advice? Visit the priest before you leave.
My daughter wants to be an adventurer because of you!
If you need anything, just ask!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.hin: The Guild Hall is near the plaza. Quests and the Receptionist are there.
The tavern rents rooms: sleeping there sets your spawn point.
The Kingdom Board in the plaza has jobs paid by the Crown.
The priest of the Church of the Dawn heals wounds and blesses travelers.
They say the fence hides in the alley... and buys anything.
The scribe at the Academy Tower sells paper, ink and books. Glyphs? Only by exploring!
The blacksmith repairs any weapon. And sells Armory gear to the renowned.
Rummaging through house chests? If someone sees, the Kingdom won't forgive.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.neu: Life here is simple, but good.
Been to the plaza? The fountain is lovely at night.
The market sells a bit of everything.
They say the Lord is fair. I hope it's true.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.nig: At night monsters prowl the walls.
Did you hear that? Must be the wind...
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.wan: You... you're wanted! Don't come near!
Pay your bail to a guard before they lock you up!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.ac: Are you tearing down the city's houses?! That's vandalism!
These walls have owners. Why were you breaking everything?
A pickaxe on someone else's home? Out with it, what got into you?
That chest belongs to the city. What do you think you were doing?
I saw you rummaging through other people's things. Explain yourself.
Looting the people's pantry in broad daylight? Start talking.
I saw your hand in that person's pocket. Thief!
Light fingers, eh? Not on my watch.
Pickpocketing in the open street. Think the guard is blind?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.br: ...I saw nothing. And you were never here.
Coins speak louder than chests. Get out of my sight.
Hm. The patrol is quiet today. Very quiet.
Are you trying to BRIBE me?! Put that away before I change my mind!
I swore an oath to my city. Your gold can't buy that.
Bribery is another crime, you know? I'm writing it down.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.fi: So it's the hard way, then!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.fl: Running, are we? Now you're Wanted!
Guards! Don't let them get away!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.ha: Don't move! I want a word with you.
Stop in the name of the law!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.im: Enough silence! You're coming with me!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.no: No coins? Then don't even try.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.pe: Don't give me stories. I know what I saw.
That excuse is old even for a tavern drunk.
Lying to the guard only makes it worse.
Hm... come to think of it, must've been a misunderstanding. Move along.
Fine, fine. I believe you. This time.
That makes sense. Sorry for the scare, %s. Good day.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.re: YOU again?! This conversation is over!
I warned you, %s. Repeat offenders go to the cell!
Again today! No excuses, no coins: in the name of the law!
Clean pockets, nothing missing... Hm. Stay away from the chests.
Nothing's gone. Sorry, but eyeing chests draws attention.
Everything back in its place. Don't let it happen again.
Late honesty is still honesty. Go in peace.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.wa: Don't turn your back on me! We're still talking.
Well? Speak up before I lose my patience.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.crime.thank: Fine blade! The Kingdom thanks you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.ambie: No goblin gets through this gate.
My spear is sharp. Monsters beware.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.bad.0: I've got my eye on you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.bad.1: One wrong step and you're off to the dungeon.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.battl: Monster in the city! With me!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.enemy: You're not welcome here. Draw or turn back!
The war has reached our gate. You shall not pass!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.exalt: The whole city is safe with you here.
Hail, %s! The guard counts on you.
Fighting by your side would be an honor.
If the Horde comes, I want you on the wall.
The lads at the barracks talk a lot about you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.hosti: You're not welcome here. Leave or be arrested!
In the name of the Kingdom, halt!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.neutr: Respect the laws and we'll be friends.
The Guild is near the plaza, if you're looking for work.
Seen any monsters on the road? Tell the guard.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.night: Stay alert. At night they come.
The bells ring if the Horde attacks.
Don't walk alone outside the walls.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.guard.wante: Pay your bail or face the spear!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.kingdom.ald: Aldoria's golden fields feed the whole realm.
They say Aldoria's king was once an adventurer.
The capital's bell rings at noon. You can hear it for miles!
Blue and gold: the colors of Aldoria.
Sahra's merchants bring spices all the way here. Pricey, but good!
The Crown of Aldoria protects those who serve it.
Nordheim and Sahra squabble over trade routes. Aldoria stays out of it... for now.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.kingdom.nor: Winter comes early in the mountains.
Warm mead chases off the cold. Want a sip?
Did you see the lights in the sky last night? The elders say they're the heroes.
A sharp axe and a lit hearth. That's all I need.
Nordheim bows neither to the cold nor to monsters.
The skalds sing the names of those who defend the north.
Sahra wants our iron cheap. Let them come fetch it in the snow!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.kingdom.sah: May the sun of Sahra light your way.
The caravans arrived from the oasis! Fresh dates!
The sand keeps ancient secrets... and basilisks.
Water is gold in the desert, traveler.
The simoom wind is coming. Cover your face!
For the Sun and the Empire!
The Empire of Sahra measures time by dunes, not by kings.
My caravans need escorts. The Guild pays well.
Nordheim sends iron; we send gold. Still, they complain.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.ambien: The realm prospers, but the Horde never rests.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.audien: You already have all my gratitude, hero. Aldoria is in your debt.
Your name is already sung in the mead halls, hero. Nordheim is in your debt.
Your legend already echoes across the dunes, hero. The Empire of Sahra is in your debt.
Keep serving the Kingdom. When you are Exalted, I'll have something worthy of a hero.
I don't know you well yet. Come back when you are %s with the Kingdom — the Kingdom Board in the plaza has work.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.bad.0: Your name has reached my ears — and not for good reasons.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.bad.1: Prove your worth to the Kingdom before asking for anything.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.city_n: Messengers speak of %1$s, about %2$s blocks %3$s of here. A journey worth making.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.exalte: Hero of %2$s! My doors are always open.
Bards already sing your tale in the taverns.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.good.0: %s! Always a pleasure to receive a friend of the Kingdom.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.good.1: Your deeds have reached the court. Keep it up.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.good.2: If you need anything, request an audience.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.hostil: Guards! Get this criminal out of my sight!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.neutra: Welcome, %s. The Kingdom always needs strong arms.
The Kingdom Board in the plaza has missions. Complete them and you'll have my attention.
Defend this city and you will be rewarded.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.news.0: Scouts saw goblins gathering in the forests. A horde may be coming.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.news.1: The Arcane Academy asks for help studying the Trial Chambers.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.news.2: The elemental shrines awaken heroes. Have you visited one?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.news.3: They say the orcs have a new warlord. Stay alert.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.news.4: The Church of the Dawn says the undead are restless in the crypts.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.news.5: The Underworld grows in the alleys. I dislike it, but... sometimes it's useful.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.reward: Kneel, %s... and rise, HERO OF ALDORIA! May these treasures serve your legend.
Kneel, %s... and rise, HERO OF NORDHEIM! The skalds will sing your name for a thousand winters.
Kneel, %s... and rise, SHIELD OF THE SUN OF SAHRA! May the Empire's gold serve your legend.
%s, your honor is known even in the castle halls. Accept this gift from the Kingdom.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.al: Hm, one more drop of wart...
This smoke is normal. I think.
Careful what you touch, %s! Some of these explode.
Potions, elixirs, mana tonics... what are you after?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.ba: Hmph. I have goods, but the price is different for you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.bl: The forge fire is perfect today.
Bring iron and I'll pay you well.
Good steel isn't made in a hurry, %s. But it sells fast!
Need a blade, armor or a repair?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.en: The stall is closed. For you, forever.
I sell nothing to those who march against us.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.ex: An honor to serve you! Take whatever you want.
Even the rare pieces are yours, hero.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.fe: Don't look at me like that.
The guards? They don't come here.
Psst, %s. Saw nothing, heard nothing. Wanna buy?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.go: For a customer like you, %s, the house's best!
I've saved some special pieces for you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.gr: The harvest was plentiful this year.
Fruits, vegetables, bread... and I buy your harvest!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.ho: I don't sell to your kind. Out!
Leave before I call the guard.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.in: Welcome to the Drunken Griffin, %s! Food, drink and a warm bed.
Have a seat! The stew is on the fire.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.je: Hm, this amethyst has a flaw.
The right jewel changes a destiny.
Ah, %s! See how these stones shine.
Amulets, rings, gems... all with true enchantment.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.ne: Take a look, %s. All quality goods!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.pr: I pray for the adventurers who left.
May the Dawn's light guide you, %s.
Wounds, curses, burdens... the Church helps.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.re: %s won't trade with you. Improve your reputation first.
No way. With your reputation? Out!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.sc: The Academy pays well for paper.
Greetings, %s. The Academy shares knowledge with the worthy.
Paper, ink, books... knowledge has a price.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.ta: Bring wool and leather and I'll pay.
What are you wearing, %s? Let me help.
Fine fabrics, Kingdom colors, tanned leather...
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.rumor.again: I already told you: look for %s. Follow the arrow!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.rumor.found: They say there's %1$s about %2$s blocks %3$s of here. Be careful out there!
A traveler swore he saw %1$s, some %2$s blocks %3$s. I wouldn't go alone...
Psst... %1$s. About %2$s blocks %3$s. Treasure, danger, or both.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.rumor.none: Hm... I haven't heard of anything interesting nearby lately.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.alt: The Ascension Altar is %1$s, about %2$s blocks away. Follow the arrow — bring your Circle's tribute!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.bai: Bail paid. Walk the line from now on.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.ble: The Dawn walks with you. Go with courage!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.cle: Done. Nothing impure remains in you.
What record? Never heard of you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.hea: May the Dawn's light close your wounds.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.man: Drink it in one go. Feel that? Fresh mana!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.no_: That's %s Guild Coins. Come back when you have them.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.rep: %s is good as new. Master's work!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.roo: Your room is the bed at %s %s %s. Rest well!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.sto: The Waystone is %1$s, about %2$s blocks away, in the plaza garden. Touch it!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.una: I can't do that right now.
The bells! The Horde is coming!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.trade_busy: I'm with another customer. One moment!
effect.isekai_mahou.aurora_blessing.desc: +4 max health, +2 armor, luck and gentle healing.
effect.isekai_mahou.wanted.description: Crime against a kingdom: THAT kingdom's guards attack on sight (other kingdoms don't care). Pay bail to one of its guards, clear your record with the fence, or wait it out.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom_nordheim.de: The kingdom of snow: stone-and-timber holds, mead halls, wolves and the Jarl in the capital Nordheim. Defend the cities and commit no crimes.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom_nordheim.pe: Nordheim's guard hunts you and no hall opens its door.
Prices −30%. Speak to the Jarl to become the Hero of Nordheim.
Prices −10%. The Jarl has a gift for you.
Nordheim's guards attack you. Northern merchants won't trade.
Normal prices in the northern cities.
Prices −20%. The skalds begin to sing your name.
Prices +25% with Nordheim's merchants. The guards are wary.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom_sahra.desc: The desert empire: sandstone cities, caravans, oases and the Sultan in the capital Sahra. Defend the cities and commit no crimes.
Janissaries hunt you across the Empire and no one trades with you.
Prices −30%. Speak to the Sultan to become the Shield of the Sun.
Prices −10%. The Sultan has a gift for you.
Sahra's guards attack you. The Empire's merchants won't trade.
Normal prices in the Empire's cities.
Prices −20%. Caravans hail you on the roads.
Prices +25% with Sahra's merchants. The guards keep watch.
message.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.fig: You resisted the guard: you are now Wanted in this realm!
message.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.fle: You fled the guard: you are now Wanted in this realm!
message.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.imp: You didn't answer the guard: you are now Wanted in this realm!
message.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.los: The guard lost sight of you.
message.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.rep: Repeat offender! The guards won't talk: you are Wanted.
message.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.see: %s saw you! Wait for the guard and explain yourself, or run (and become Wanted).
message.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.hero.sa: ✦ SHIELD OF THE SUN OF SAHRA ✦
message.isekai_mahou.cities.murder: Murder! The Kingdom will never forget this crime.
message.isekai_mahou.cities.respawn.guar: A new guard, %s, took the post in %s.
message.isekai_mahou.cities.rested: You wake up Rested: health, stamina and mana renewed.
message.isekai_mahou.cities.room_night: %s slept in a rented tavern room — the night passed.
message.isekai_mahou.cities.seen: %s saw you rummaging through the chest!
message.isekai_mahou.cities.siege_failed: The Horde plundered %s and retreated into the dark...
message.isekai_mahou.cities.wanted: You are now WANTED in %s! Its guards are coming for you.
objective.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.w: Wait for the guard (%ss); running = Wanted
objective.isekai_mahou.cities.guide.deta: Follow the arrow (a resident showed you the way)
reason.isekai_mahou.cities.bribe_attempt: tried to bribe an honest guard
reputation.isekai_mahou.title.kingdom_sa: Shield of the Sun of Sahra
rumor.isekai_mahou.cities.structure.fals: an abandoned village... far too quiet
rumor.isekai_mahou.cities.structure.guil: a village with a Guild hall
rumor.isekai_mahou.cities.structure.hydr: a hydra's lair in the swamp
screen.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.brib: Coins close eyes... most of the time. Honest guards take offense (−3 reputation).
This guard is honest. Don't try again.
screen.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.figh: Wanted for %s min in this realm and the guards attack. Bail with any guard of the realm.
screen.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.flee: Wanted for %s min in this realm. You get a few seconds' head start.
screen.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.note: Seen meddling with a city chest.
Mark %s/%s: FINAL WARNING, the next one means the cell.
Repeat-offense marks: %s/%s (on the 3rd: Wanted, no talking).
screen.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.pers: Convince the guard it was a mistake. One try only; failing costs 2 reputation.
You already tried. He won't fall for it again.
screen.isekai_mahou.cities.confront.retu: Nothing is missing: you show your pockets, all reputation comes back and the mark is cleared.
Returns %s and the guard repairs %s block(s). Half the reputation comes back and the mark is cleared.
You don't have everything to give back. Missing: %s
screen.isekai_mahou.cities.trade_locked: Refuses to trade with you (reputation too low).
Free: an arrow on the tracker to the city's public altar. Bring your Circle's tribute!
service.isekai_mahou.cities.audience.des: The Lord's rewards when you reach Honored and Exalted with the Kingdom.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.bail.desc: Clears "Wanted" in this kingdom and its guards stop chasing you.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.blessing.des: 10 minutes: +4 max health, +2 armor, luck and gentle healing.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.cleanse.desc: Removes conditions, curses and harmful effects (does not erase crimes).
service.isekai_mahou.cities.clear_record: A discreet "contract": "Wanted" disappears in EVERY kingdom. The Underworld thanks you.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.heal.desc: Restores all health and puts out fire.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.mana.desc: An arcane tonic that fills your mana.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.repair.desc: Makes the item in your hand as good as new.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.room.desc: The bed becomes your spawn point. Sleep in it at night and wake up Rested.
Free: an arrow to the plaza's Waystone. Touch it to discover the destination and travel.
title.isekai_mahou.cities.siege.sub: The Horde approaches from the gate to the %s!
toast.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.exalted.s: Shield of the Sun of Sahra!
toast.isekai_mahou.cities.lord.honored.s: Honored with the Empire of Sahra
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.me: New vehicles, parts and repairs. What will it be?
A Sky Galleon... one day I'll build one.
A crystal in the tank and the world is yours.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.vehicle_repa: The vehicle in your hand, or yours parked nearby (up to 16 blocks), is made whole.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.vehicle_rebu: A vehicle of yours that was destroyed comes back whole, upgrades included (empty tank).
service.isekai_mahou.cities.vehicle_reco: A vehicle of yours left far away or lost comes back to your inventory; the old copy vanishes wherever it is.
